data.title: What hosts ask us.
items: Yes, if nobody pays to attend. Catch charges 5% only when people buy tickets, and free events stay free.
Can we keep it to our company?
Yes. Make the event invite-only: it stays off public pages and only people with your private link can RSVP.
No. They RSVP, check in and see their group in their phone’s browser.
Can you run a multi-day offsite?
Yes, with programmes: arrivals, transport, rooms, forms and messages for everyone attending. Book a walkthrough and we’ll set it up with you.
Can we hire a host to run it?
Not through Catch yet. Many quiz, supper and run hosts on Catch run private events; message them from their page.
Who RSVP’d and came, and, if you ask for feedback, ratings and how many new people they met. It never shows anyone’s private answers.
